overall_limitations: Several compound rubric facts are split across claims; their fragments do not individually receive the complete rubric key.
The positive-threshold condition, successful-RESTART condition, and all-database output exception require more precise wording.
No claim duplicates an earlier claim with the same specifics.
The claims omit fixed reader end marks, wal-index lookup and host restrictions, the single-writer limit, and WAL-size-related read cost.
The packet cannot establish an independent-source requirement or research saturation.
